description: This file defines API routes for managing datasets, including upload, listing, downloading, and deletion functionalities in a FastAPI application. It uses various FastAPI components, interacts with a storage service, and references dataset schemas.

methods.name: UploadResponse upload_dataset( file: UploadFile = File(..., description="CSV or JSONL dataset file"), storage: StorageService = get_storage_service, )
methods.description: Handles uploading of CSV or JSONL dataset files to the server and returns an upload response.

methods.name: List[DatasetInfo] list_datasets( storage: StorageService = get_storage_service, )
methods.description: Lists all uploaded datasets with metadata such as filename, size, and modification date.

methods.name: FileResponse download_dataset( filename: str = Query(..., description="Dataset filename"), storage: StorageService = get_storage_service, )
methods.description: Provides a dataset file for download based on filename query parameter.

methods.name: None delete_dataset( filename: str = Query(..., description="Dataset filename"), storage: StorageService = get_storage_service, )
methods.description: Deletes a specified dataset file from storage.
